dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Oh, are you a guest from outside the village? If you haven't tried fishing, I implore you give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Haha, the look on your face tells me it's either you dislike fishing, or you're too good at it.

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Anyway, one must have a hobby to whittle away free time. I think fishing is a good way to go about that.

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Sure, let's fish together when you have time!

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Isn't this the guest Rana brought? What's up, is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Oh, those "tiger cubs"... They want to go into the forest every day, but children should have this sort of energy.

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Sudabeh and Kavus are just the child-version of me, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: But I hope they can be more careful. They have been missing for days before. Everyone in the village was worried sick...

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Oh, if only my wife were here... She would be able to keep all the children in line.

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: But she's a busy researcher. Right now she's in the Akademiya, conducting some sort of research...

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean my father. His eyesight has become worse, but he is still hale and hearty otherwise because he wanted to be an adventurer when he was young.

dialogues.speaker: Iosaphat
dialogues.text: Haha, okay then... By the way, come fishing with me when you get the time!
